import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MODULO = 1000000007;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int T = 1; // As per original code, T is fixed to 1
        for (int _ = 0; _ < T; _++) {
            processCase(scanner);
        }
        scanner.close();
    }

    static void processCase(Scanner scanner) {
        int total_points = scanner.nextInt();
        int multiplier = scanner.nextInt();

        int[] sequence = new int[total_points];
        for (int i = 0; i < total_points; i++) {
            sequence[i] = (int)((long)multiplier * i % total_points);
        }

        if (multiplier == 0) {
            System.out.println(powMod(total_points, total_points - 1, MODULO));
            return;
        }

        boolean[] visited_nodes = new boolean[total_points];
        int[] cycle_sizes = new int[total_points + 1]; // size index up to total_points
        long answer = 1;

        for (int start_node = 0; start_node < total_points; start_node++) {
            if (visited_nodes[start_node]) {
                continue;
            }
            int cycle_length = 0;
            int node = start_node;
            while (!visited_nodes[node]) {
                visited_nodes[node] = true;
                node = sequence[node];
                cycle_length++;
            }
            cycle_sizes[cycle_length]++;
        }

        for (int size = 1; size < total_points; size++) {
            int count = cycle_sizes[size];
            if (count != 0) {
                long total = size * (long)count + (size > 1 ? 1 : 0);
                answer = (answer * powMod(total, count, MODULO)) % MODULO;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(answer);
    }

    static long powMod(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1;
        long current_power = base % mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * current_power) % mod;
            }
            current_power = (current_power * current_power) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
}
